stage3b_implant_dll.description: C2 implant DLL (file.dll) — WinINet HTTP beacon with ConnectorHTTP class, RC4-encrypted config in .rdata, export: _Z11GetVersionsv

stage4_decrypted_config.description: RC4-decrypted C2 configuration blob from implant DLL .rdata section
